The Router's assessment of 'structural_collapse' on the right edge (Severity 2.0) is supported by the slight warping visible in the image, though the Topology mask suggests it's not a catastrophic break. I agree with the severities; the text artifact is the most critical failure.

It passes the broad geometric checks but fails the fine-grained functional details of a real comic book cover.
